questions.question: A friend says, *'I’ve been trying to book tickets for the concert, but they’re all sold out. Do you mind if I borrow yours?'* What is the most appropriate response?
options: Of course not! I was planning to go anyway, but thanks for asking.
I’m sorry, I already bought mine last week—maybe next time?
That’s not a problem at all! I’ll just get some from a friend.
I don’t have any left—I’m going to go myself.
questions.answer: Of course not! I was planning to go anyway, but thanks for asking.

questions.question: During a team meeting, someone suggests, *'Let’s start the project by next Friday.'* Another team member replies, *'That’s a great idea! I think we should actually aim for Thursday if we want to finish on time.'* Which response best reflects a **formal** agreement?
options: Yes, absolutely—I’ll make sure to update everyone’s plans accordingly.
That sounds fine, but we should double-check the deadline with HR first.
I’m not sure if Thursday is feasible—maybe we should stick to Friday?
I agree, but we should also include the manager in this discussion.
questions.answer: Yes, absolutely—I’ll make sure to update everyone’s plans accordingly.

questions.question: A customer at a café says, *'I’m sorry, but my coffee’s gone cold. Did I order it wrong?'* The barista replies, *'Not at all—it’s fine! I’ll just make you another one right away.'* What is the most **polite** response from the customer?
options: That’s really kind of you! I appreciate it.
Oh, I didn’t realise—thanks for fixing it.
I’m glad you’re happy with it—I’ll just take my order then.
Actually, I think I’d like a latte instead, if that’s okay.
questions.answer: That’s really kind of you! I appreciate it.

questions.question: In a debate, someone says, *'I think climate change is being exaggerated—natural disasters happen all the time, so it’s not really a crisis.'* Which response best **disagrees** politely while offering a counterpoint?
options: I completely agree—natural disasters are more common than people think.
I see your point, but studies show that recent disasters are linked to rising temperatures.
You’re wrong—climate change is the biggest problem we face today.
I don’t think you’re being serious—this is a serious issue.
questions.answer: I see your point, but studies show that recent disasters are linked to rising temperatures.

questions.question: A colleague asks, *'Do you have time to help me with this report before the meeting tomorrow?'* You have a prior commitment but want to be polite. What is the best response?
options: I’m afraid I’m busy tomorrow, but I’ll see if I can help later this week.
No, I don’t think I can—maybe you should ask someone else?
I’ll definitely help you—just let me know what you need!
I’m sorry, but I’ve already promised to work on another project.
questions.answer: I’m afraid I’m busy tomorrow, but I’ll see if I can help later this week.
